# Protocodus

> Protocodus s.r.o. is an independent software and audio engineering studio based in Prague, Czech Republic, founded by Vojtěch Hordějčuk on March 5, 2026. Protocodus develops RILL (a free, open-source desktop music workstation), Reason Rack Extensions (physically modelled acoustic instruments, circuit-modelled synthesizers, and audio effects for the Reason Studios Rack), command-line audio tools, and ad-free browser games.

## Desktop Software & Audio Tools

- [RILL — Free, Open-Source Music Workstation](https://protocodus.cz/product/rill/): Free native DAW for macOS, Linux, and Windows (v0.1.0 Alpha, MIT License). Audio and MIDI recording, audio take comping, piano roll, non-destructive audio editing, built-in R1 instruments (Mini synth, Sampler, Drums) and R1 effects (Filter, Equalizer, Saturator, Compressor, Modulator, Spacer echo and reverb), isolated VST3, CLAP, LV2 (Linux) and Audio Unit (macOS) instruments/effects, buses/sends/sidechains, channel and Master automation, reversible Freeze, portable projects with embedded audio, and optional scoped OpenAI/Anthropic assistance with the user’s API key. Independent processing chains can use multiple CPU cores without reducing sample precision; performance depends on the project and hardware. [GitHub](https://github.com/protocodus/rill-daw)
- [Podcare](https://protocodus.cz/#products): Python command-line podcast production tool that cleans, aligns, and levels multi-microphone recordings with noise reduction, filler-word removal, and loudness mastering.

## Published Reason Rack Extensions

- [Acustra — Acoustic Guitar](https://protocodus.cz/product/acustra/): Physically modelled six-string steel-string acoustic guitar Rack Extension (v1.9.0, released 2026-10-20) with four body shapes, fingerpicking and strumming engines, and microphone/piezo capture. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/acustra-acoustic-guitar/)
- [YouKnow — Circuit-Modelled Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/youknow/): Circuit-modelled 1–16 voice polyphonic synthesizer Rack Extension (v1.3.5, released 2026-10-05) with nonlinear resonant low-pass filter, stereo BBD chorus, per-voice component variation, and 100 authored Rack patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/youknow-circuit-modelled-synth/)
- [Maremba — Marimba, Balafon & Kalimba](https://protocodus.cz/product/maremba/): Physically modelled mallet and tine percussion Rack Extension (v1.5.7, released 2026-10-13) modelling concert and Guatemalan marimbas, balafon, and kalimba with seven audio outputs and 20 patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/maremba/)
- [Ceres — Circuit-Modelled Synth](https://protocodus.cz/product/ceres/): Dual-layer circuit-modelled polyphonic synthesizer Rack Extension (v1.1.4, released 2026-11-02) with 1–16 voices per layer, high- and low-pass filters, SUB oscillator, ring modulation, and 23 patches. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/ceres-circuit-modelled-synth/)
- [Press78 — FM Synthesizer](https://protocodus.cz/product/press78/): Twelve-voice editable two-operator FM synthesizer Rack Extension (v1.0.4, released 2026-11-02) inspired by vintage FM keyboards with stereo chorus and modelled output circuit. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/press78-fm-synth/)
- [Binaurel — 3D Headphone Panner](https://protocodus.cz/product/binaurel/): 3D binaural headphone panner Rack Extension (v0.1.0, released 2026-11-04) with measured KU100 ear cues, azimuth, elevation, distance, room control, and six CV inputs. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/binaurel-advanced-panner/)
- [Lamer Degrader — Creative Codec Effect](https://protocodus.cz/product/lamer/): Real-time MP3 and Ogg Vorbis compression degradation effect Rack Extension (v1.0.0, released 2026-10-21) with 8–256 kbps bitrate targets, 1–4 encoding passes, and aligned dry/wet mixing. [Reason Shop](https://www.reasonstudios.com/shop/rack-extension/lamer-degrader/)

## Reason Rack Extensions in Review & Development

- [Respira — Modelled Accordion](https://protocodus.cz/product/respira/): Physically modelled accordion Rack Extension (v0.1.16d1 submitted; latest build 0.1.27f1) with eight registers, bass and chord buttons, and automatic or manual modulation-wheel bellows.
- [Acukoto — Modelled Koto](https://protocodus.cz/product/acukoto/): Physically modelled 13-string paulownia koto Rack Extension (v0.18.0d1 accepted; latest build 0.25.16d1) with movable bridges, two tunings, sympathetic resonance, and left-hand pitch bends.
- [Keyra — Modelled Grand Piano](https://protocodus.cz/product/keyra/): Physically modelled piano Rack Extension (latest build 1.0.0f2) combining components from five grand models and an upright with three continuous pedals and 14 patches.
- [Aculele — Modelled Ukulele](https://protocodus.cz/product/aculele/): Physically modelled ukulele Rack Extension (v0.4.39d1 accepted; latest build 0.4.64d1) with soprano, concert, and tenor bodies, nylon or fluorocarbon strings, and mic/piezo capture.
- [Aculyre — Modelled Lyre](https://protocodus.cz/product/aculyre/): Physically modelled lyre harp Rack Extension (v0.7.9d1 accepted; latest build 0.13.5d1) with three instruments, steel/nylon/gut strings, sympathetic resonance, and mic/piezo capture.
- [Remix — Crossfader Utility](https://protocodus.cz/product/remix/): Free 3U crossfader utility Rack Extension (latest build 1.1.0f4) with Shape and Skew curve controls, live scope, and CV control.
- [Convretor — Audio to CV Utility](https://protocodus.cz/product/convretor/): Compact 3U audio-to-CV utility Rack Extension (latest build 0.1.0d9) driving four CV outputs with independent scale, polarity, and high/low-pass input filtering.
- [Retra — Retro Processor](https://protocodus.cz/product/retra/): Stereo retro processor Rack Extension (latest build 0.7.0f2) chaining eight modelled stages (distortion, cassette or vinyl, wobble, dropouts, signal-reactive noise, amplifier, speaker, and digital or MP3/Ogg) under one Amount knob, with 20 patches.
- [Electry — Modelled Electric Guitar](https://protocodus.cz/product/electry/): Physically modelled six-string electric guitar Rack Extension (latest build 2.4.6d1) with three single-coil pickups, a floating tremolo bridge, 15 technique keyswitches, and a direct signal for your own amp.

## Playable Browser Games

- [Protocodus Browser Games](https://protocodus.cz/fun/): Six self-contained HTML5/WebGL browser games playable with no installation, account, or advertisements.
- [Tyran](https://protocodus.cz/fun/tyran/): Arcade vertical space shooter across ten sectors with squadron formations, boss guardians, wing drones, and ship upgrades.
- [Ashline](https://protocodus.cz/fun/ashline/): Sci-fi real-time strategy game with a ten-operation campaign and skirmish modes featuring Organics and AI Unity factions, base building, power logistics, and unit promotions.
- [Alpen](https://protocodus.cz/fun/alpen/): Endless 3D alpine snowboarding game with changing weather, carving, grabs, flips, and score combos.
- [Meteora](https://protocodus.cz/fun/meteora/): Story-driven 3D space combat game with ten campaign missions, tactical briefings, ship loadouts, and survival mode in the Meteora asteroid belt.
- [Hedgerow](https://protocodus.cz/fun/hedgerow/): First-person World War II shooter with three operations set in the Normandy hedgerows in July 1944.
- [Puzzle Box](https://protocodus.cz/fun/puzzles/): Two 3D logic puzzle games for kids and adults — Zipper (single-line pathing) and Patcher (board region cutting) — with daily puzzles and three difficulty sizes.
